adjudication.rationale: In `parseRefreshTokenResponse` the `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is used when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is set. That schema does not explicitly include `refresh_token` (and Zod `object()` defaults to stripping unknown keys unless `.passthrough()` is used), so a real `refresh_token` from the response (or from an object being parsed) can be dropped. The function then forcibly sets `refresh_token` to the literal string "refresh_token" when missing, and downstream code merges `tokenResponse.data` into the persisted credential (e.g. Office365: `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };` then `prisma.credential.update(...)`), which would overwrite the real refresh token and corrupt stored credentials.
